title: IntentRecord
description: One approved edit request. The filmmaker reviews and approves this record BEFORE rendering. An LLM may draft it; approval is human, and approval of one revision can never authorize a different media digest or an expanded edit.

intent_revision.description: Monotonic revision number. Expanding the edit area or changing the operation requires a new revision with a new approval.

source_digest.description: Immutable digest of the source media this intent applies to.

frame_rate.description: Rational frame rate (e.g. 24000/1001). Decimal fps hides NTSC rates.

requested_operation.description: What the filmmaker asked for, in their words plus a normalized verb.

allowed_edit_region.description: Region the edit is authorized to change. This is the authorization boundary; it may not be silently expanded.

path.description: Path to the mask/region asset, referenced by digest in RunRecord.

allowed_consequence_region.description: Region where SECOND-ORDER changes are legitimate (e.g. a shadow or interacting object). A checker that treats every changed pixel as failure would reject correct results.

protected_content.description: What must survive the edit. Each entry names a review-signal class that will be checked.

region.description: Region descriptor, same shape as allowed_edit_region.

mode.description: Hard constraint. Audio retention policy mismatches are failures, not review signals.

items.description: Shot id; adjacent shots used for continuity checks.

approved_record_digest.description: The approval binding. sha256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace) of the approval-bound fields: intent_revision, project_id, shot_id, source_digest, frame_range, frame_rate, requested_operation, allowed_edit_region, allowed_consequence_region, protected_content, audio_policy, reference_shots. The approver signs exactly this revision; changing any bound field (a different media digest or an expanded edit) requires a new intent_revision and a new approval.
